children: Mission Produce, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue rising to $450M from $357.7M a year earlier, while the company swung to a net loss and reported diluted EPS of ($0.08). The increase in net sales was driven by Marketing & Distribution volume gains following the Calavo integration, even as profitability declined versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share attributable to Mission Produce”.
Revenue Growth: Net sales rose ~26% YoY in the quarter, led by Marketing & Distribution volume growth following the Calavo acquisition integration.
Channel & Mix Shift: Marketing & Distribution ramped after the acquisition; Prepared Foods was introduced via Calavo, adding value‑added SKUs.
Brand & Scale Momentum: The Calavo acquisition expanded North American avocado supply reliability and entered Mission Produce into the prepared foods category.
Operational Milestones: The company submitted approximately $12.5M in IEEPA tariff refund claims; recognized refunds affected gross profit and blueberry results.
Supply & Farming: Mexican yields and harvested volumes increased, while International Farming experienced lower prices amid higher global supply.
